name: yaks.app
description: Build an app by asking Claude or ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Ask for an app and it is made, deployed and live at an address of its own. Every app keeps its own data, opens on a phone, and can be changed by asking again.
defaultPrompt: Build me a recipe box I can search and tag.
Make a page where my team signs up for shifts.
Show me my apps and what is broken in them.
